chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from al-Sayyari from Ali ibn Asbat from one of his companions who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Honor the bread.' It was said, 'And what is its honoring?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'When it is placed, do not wait with it for something else.'
ai.seo_question: What is the proper etiquette for honoring bread according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defines the honor of bread (ikram al-khubz) by instructing that it should not be left waiting for other dishes, a practice rooted in Shia etiquette to prevent waste and show gratitude for sustenance. This specific guidance reflects the broader Islamic principle of valuing staple foods, which are often cited as the primary blessing in the household, thereby elevating the mundane act of eating into an act of worship.
